metadata.title: Bitcoin Is The Best Hedge Fund That's Ever Existed
metadata.speaker: Anthony Pompliano (interviewer), Jordi Visser 'Jordy' (guest)

executive_takeaway: (1) The Leopold hedge fund unwind was a 'cleansing event' - forced liquidation of positions via prime brokers. He was up 400% YTD through June with ~$25B in the fund, suffered ~80% drawdown in July, still has $10B+ remaining. Everyone was crowded into the same AI trades. (2) Market structure is fundamentally changing: AI agents are entering decision-making, hedge fund leverage was at all-time highs, and 'speed crashes' will happen more frequently. What used to take 30 years now takes 3 years. Leverage won't return to highs. (3) Compute scarcity is the defining constraint: OpenAI and Anthropic underestimated supply needs. SpaceX and Meta have excess capacity they'll eventually need. Demand (especially for video/token-hungry use cases) vastly exceeds supply. 'We underestimated the amount of supply.' (4) Bitcoin is the best hedge fund ever - its early returns mirror Leopold's pattern (huge drawdowns then compounding). The MicroStrategy situation will become the norm as AI creates competitive pressure + debasement. (5) Over 5 years, $700T global net worth will see money redistributed into crypto (targeting $100T in a decade). Tokenization of real-world assets will unlock dormant capital through fractionalization and daily liquidity. (6) Borders are breaking down: with crypto + AI + stablecoins, you can run a business from anywhere with AI agents replacing employees. The Philippines economy was already transformed by Axie Infinity.

conviction_map.topic: Bitcoin as Best Hedge Fund Ever
conviction_map.core_thesis: Bitcoin's early returns look like Leopold's hedge fund pattern - huge drawdowns (70-80%) then compounding. 'You don't find Bitcoin, Bitcoin finds you' - it appears when businesses/funds are destroyed and need a store of value. Every business will end up in a MicroStrategy-like situation within 5 years as AI creates competitive pressure and debasement.
conviction_map.risks: Regulatory crackdown; technological obsolescence; correlation with risk assets during crisis; adoption slower than predicted

conviction_map.core_thesis: OpenAI and Anthropic underestimated compute supply. SpaceX and Meta have excess capacity they'll eventually need. Demand (especially video/token-hungry use cases like Disney movie production) vastly exceeds supply. Sam Altman said 'we underestimated the amount of supply.' Physical constraints (molecules) limit digital transformation (bits).
conviction_map.risks: Algorithmic breakthroughs reduce demand; new capacity comes online faster; demand destruction from economic downturn

conviction_map.core_thesis: Tokenization will unlock $700T of dormant assets through fractionalization and daily liquidity. ETFs tokenized will give access to every asset class. Just as no one believed in ETFs in 2000, tokenization will dominate by default. Fed can delever via tokenization releasing money supply.
conviction_map.risks: Regulatory pushback; technical delays; traditional finance resistance; custody/security concerns

conviction_map.core_thesis: AI will destroy the growth certainty of all companies as AI-native startups (often 1 person with an AI agent running 100 businesses) compete on everything. Multiples should compress. Small businesses win. Public markets may be effectively unchanged but private businesses grow valuations.
conviction_map.risks: Timeline longer than expected; regulation could slow AI adoption; AI-native dominance may not materialize

conviction_map.core_thesis: Hedge fund leverage won't return to highs. Fed wants to delever (shrink balance sheet). More bubbles, parabolas, and speed crashes ahead. Prime brokers will extend less leverage after Leopold-style events. Agentic trading platforms provide discipline for individuals.
conviction_map.risks: Inflation forces Fed to re-expand balance sheet; crisis requires aggressive policy response; leveraged demand returns

companies_assets.status: NEGATIVE VIEW (case study in leverage risk)
companies_assets.view: Young hedge fund manager, ~25 years old, built a $25B fund with 400% YTD gains through June. Suffered ~80% drawdown in July during the AI stock unwind. Forced to liquidate entire book via prime brokers. Still had $10B+ remaining. Represented the crowded AI trade narrative. 'Cleansing event' rather than catastrophe.
companies_assets.why: Exemplifies the dangers of crowded trades + excessive leverage in the age of faster markets. Prime broker network amplified the liquidation.
companies_assets.catalysts: AI stock correction; Fed meeting; prime broker liquidation cascade
companies_assets.risks: Career recovery; fundraising future; reputation damage

companies_assets.view: Not currently needing all its AI compute capacity (reserved for future humanoid/robotics projects). Has sold excess capacity to Anthropic and Google. Elon can outbuild virtually anyone when needed. Excess capacity positions SpaceX as a compute landlord.
companies_assets.why: Represents the physical infrastructure (energy/molecules) side that constrains digital AI. Elon's 'builder' reputation gives edge in compute race.
companies_assets.catalysts: Starship launches; Optimus humanoid deployment; Dojo supercomputer scaling
companies_assets.risks: Starship failures; regulatory pushback; competition from Amazon/Google/Microsoft

companies_assets.view: Has excess compute capacity beyond current AI agent needs (personal agents not yet mature). Building out massive data center infrastructure. Could monetize excess capacity if market conditions change.
companies_assets.why: Meta's compute build-out represents the physical constraint side of the AI revolution. Positioned as infrastructure owner.
companies_assets.catalysts: Llama model releases; Ray-Ban smart glasses; metaverse development
companies_assets.risks: Adoption slower than projected; regulatory AI restrictions; competition

companies_assets.view: Jordi is adding positions - bought 2 weeks ago, added more at lower prices. Physical scarcity (HBM/memory) drives earnings growth. Margins at levels never seen before in memory stocks. Short-term multiple compression risk but secular demand intact.
companies_assets.why: Memory/silicon scarcity is the bottleneck for AI compute. Micron benefits from finite supply + exploding demand for AI infrastructure.
companies_assets.catalysts: HBM demand; AI server deployment; pricing power
companies_assets.risks: Cyclical downturn; new memory capacity; AI capex pause

companies_assets.view: Part of Jordi's scarcity thesis - along with Bitcoin and Micron, represents the 'molecule' side (physical energy infrastructure) that constrains the 'bits' (digital AI) transformation.
companies_assets.why: Energy is a physical constraint that can't be solved by software alone. Nuclear, natural gas, grid modernization required for AI data centers.
companies_assets.catalysts: Grid modernization; nuclear renaissance; offshore wind projects
companies_assets.risks: Policy changes; interest rate sensitivity; execution risk

technology_ai_views.view: The real bottleneck for AI is not chips/GPUs but HBM memory and energy. OpenAI and Anthropic underestimated supply needs. SpaceX and Meta have excess capacity they'll eventually need. Demand (video, personal agents) vastly exceeds supply. Sam Altman admitted 'we underestimated.'
technology_ai_views.companies: OpenAI, Anthropic, SpaceX, Meta, Nvidia, Micron, Samsung, SK Hynix
technology_ai_views.why: Physical constraints (molecules) limit digital transformation (bits). Compute scarcity caps AI adoption speed.

technology_ai_views.view: Market structure changing as AI agents make faster decisions. What took 30 years now takes 3 years. Speed crashes (like Leopold) will happen more. Leverage decreasing. Agentic trading platforms (Arch Public) automate capital rotation across asset classes.
technology_ai_views.companies: Leopold, Citadel, Arch Public, Figure Markets, Or Public
technology_ai_views.why: Enables faster decision cycles, reduces human emotion in trading, creates new market dynamics.

technology_ai_views.theme: China's AI Plan via Open Source
technology_ai_views.view: China pursuing AI dominance through open-source strategy. Kevin Rudd (via Ezra Klein) revealed China's AI plan aimed at addressing K-shaped economy and Western decline. Views socialism rising in the West as opportunity. China owns manufacturing ('molecules') already.
technology_ai_views.why: Geopolitical implications for global AI leadership and supply chains.

ai_workflows.name: Agentic Capital Rotation
ai_workflows.goal: Automatically take profits in outperforming markets and rotate capital into emerging opportunities without emotional interference
ai_workflows.tools: Or Public agentic trading platform, crypto-backed loans (Figure Markets), tax loss harvesting across asset classes
ai_workflows.approach: Set rules: when one market hits new all-time highs, automatically take profits and rotate capital into other markets showing more opportunity. Platform handles tax loss harvesting using crypto's exemption from wash sale rules. Works across stocks, commodities, ETFs, and crypto.
ai_workflows.why: Removes emotion from trading. Ensures capital is always working optimally. Captures gains at peaks and redeploy into emerging opportunities automatically.

ai_workflows.name: Crypto-Backed Liquidity (Figure Markets)
ai_workflows.goal: Unlock capital from Bitcoin holdings without selling or triggering taxes
ai_workflows.tools: Figure Markets crypto-backed loans at 8.91% interest with 50% LTV, decentralized MPC custody, liquidation protection
ai_workflows.approach: Instead of selling Bitcoin while it's down (which locks in losses and loses future upside), use it as collateral for a loan. Bitcoin stays in segregated wallet, is never rehypothecated or pooled, and you get cash without taxes or giving up exposure.
ai_workflows.why: Preserves Bitcoin upside while providing liquidity. Critical for long-term holders who need capital without selling. Solves the 'worst move is selling while down' problem.

predictions.prediction: Every business will end up in a MicroStrategy-like situation within 5 years
predictions.reasoning: AI creates competitive pressure + monetary debasement. Businesses that don't hold appreciating assets (like Bitcoin) will lose to those that do. Bitcoin finds you when your business is destroyed by competition or debasement.
predictions.invalidated_by: Crypto regulatory crackdown; Bitcoin price stays flat/declines for 5+ years; businesses find better stores of value

predictions.prediction: Global net worth redistributes from $3T crypto to $100T within a decade
predictions.reasoning: Total household net worth is ~$700T. Crypto is ~$3T. Over 5 years, money redistributes as people discover value in tokenized assets. Private businesses with AI-native models grow faster than public markets. Tokenization enables fractional ownership and daily liquidity.
predictions.invalidated_by: Major crypto collapse; regulatory shutdown; traditional finance successfully blocks tokenization
predictions.assets: Ethereum, Solana, Sui, BitTensor, tokenization platforms

predictions.prediction: Speed crashes will become more frequent as AI agents speed up financial markets
predictions.reasoning: AI agents make decisions faster. What took 30 years now takes 3 years. Leverage was at all-time highs. The Leopold event is a harbinger - expect more leverage-induced unwinds, faster market corrections. Leverage won't return to previous highs.
predictions.invalidated_by: AI adoption slows; regulators cap leverage reduction; market stabilizes

notable_quotes.quote: You don't find Bitcoin, Bitcoin finds you.
notable_quotes.speaker: Jordi Visser
notable_quotes.context: On how Bitcoin adoption happens - it appears when businesses/funds are destroyed and need a store of value to park money while figuring out a plan. Most people reject it as a scam initially.

notable_quotes.quote: We underestimated the amount of supply.
notable_quotes.speaker: Sam Altman (via Jordi Visser recounting)
notable_quotes.context: On OpenAI's realization that compute demand vastly exceeds supply. Physical constraints of building data centers and securing chips/HBM memory were underestimated by everyone.

notable_quotes.quote: Speed crashes are going to happen more.
notable_quotes.speaker: Jordi Visser
notable_quotes.context: On the new market regime - what took 30 years now takes 3 years. AI agents speed up everything. More bubbles, more parabolas, and more speed crashes ahead.

notable_quotes.quote: I'm excited to meet my maker.
notable_quotes.speaker: Ben Wilson
notable_quotes.context: Told to Chris Williamson 6 weeks after being diagnosed with stage 4 cancer - expressing excitement about death rather than fear, rooted in faith.

notable_quotes.quote: The million in My First Million doesn't necessarily mean dollars, but it means the first unit of richness that you can have in your life.
notable_quotes.speaker: Chris Williamson (Shawn)
notable_quotes.context: Clarifying the podcast's core thesis - richness in life comes in many forms beyond money.

notable_quotes.quote: If you don't believe in Bitcoin, you have to go back at some point and go listen to the Michael Saylor interviews in 2021 about why he did this.
notable_quotes.speaker: Jordi Visser
notable_quotes.context: On understanding Bitcoin as a hedge against competitive innovation + debasement, following Michael Saylor's Two Forces framework.

notable_quotes.quote: What took 30 years is now taking 3 years.
notable_quotes.speaker: Jordi Visser
notable_quotes.context: On the acceleration of everything due to AI agents - markets, innovation, competition, and market corrections all happen faster now.

notable_quotes.quote: I think over the course of the next 5 years AI will destroy all public companies.
notable_quotes.speaker: Jordi Visser
notable_quotes.context: On how AI will destroy growth certainty of companies as AI-native startups (often 1 person + AI agent) compete on everything. Not business failure - just multiple compression and unpredictability.

risks.text: Jordi's track record on calls is mixed - he's had bullish calls that didn't pan out. His livelihood depends on bullish narratives, creating inherent bias toward positive outcomes.
The $100T crypto market cap prediction requires massive institutional adoption, regulatory clarity, and infrastructure scaling that may not occur within a decade.
The 'every business ends up like MicroStrategy' scenario assumes Bitcoin appreciation outpaces all other investment opportunities, which is not guaranteed.
China AI plan assessment relies on secondhand reporting (Ezra Klein to Kevin Rudd). The geopolitical narrative may be oversimplified or filtered through Western perspectives.
Transcript from auto-captions may have errors, especially around the hedge fund details, technical AI descriptions, and the unnamed billionaire's claims.

actionable_takeaways.item: Bitcoin is for crisis moments - when competitive pressure or debasement hits. Position now before your business faces its 'MicroStrategy moment.' The 'worst move is selling while down.'
Use crypto-backed loans (Figure Markets: 8.91%, 50% LTV, MPC custody) instead of selling Bitcoin. Unlock liquidity without taxes or losing future upside.
Reduce leverage in your personal/corporate portfolio. Speed crashes are coming more frequently. AI agents speed up markets - what took 30 years now takes 3.
Build a 'clean sheet' approach to investing - regularly reset your portfolio, don't let crowded positions define you. After drawdowns, you can be more attractive with a chip on your shoulder.
Practice curiosity across geopolitical and technical domains - Jordi connects dots from Kurdish politics to Chinese AI plans to tokenomics. Broad knowledge compounds.

other_notable_news.title: Ben Wilson's Stage 4 Cancer Diagnosis
other_notable_news.detail: Ben Wilson (former MFM producer, host of 'How to Take Over the World') was diagnosed with stage 4 lung cancer 6 weeks prior. Never smoked, never drank. Responded with extraordinary dignity - moved house, raised $400K fundraiser, started a 365-day journal ('zero to 365') for his kids. Expressed excitement to 'meet his maker.'

other_notable_news.title: Ferrero Family Dynasty: 3 Generations
other_notable_news.detail: Gen 1: post-WWII chocolate bar pioneer (too hard to spread). Gen 2: son rebranded to Nutella with hazelnuts, created Tic Tac form factor. Gen 3: grandson adopted Buffett-style private equity, acquiring value brands (Butterfingers, Baby Ruth, Crunch). Ultra-secretive - like Area 51.

other_notable_news.title: China's Open-Source AI Strategy via Kevin Rudd
other_notable_news.detail: Kevin Rudd (former Australian PM) told Ezra Klein that China views the Western K-shaped economy as an opportunity - socialism rising as inequality grows. China owns manufacturing ('molecules') already and is pursuing AI dominance through open-source strategy.

glossary.definition: Unidentified young hedge fund manager (~25yo) that was up 400% YTD through June on ~$25B AUM, suffered ~80% drawdown in July during AI stock unwind, forced to liquidate via prime brokers. Still had $10B+ remaining. Became a cautionary tale about crowded trades + leverage.

Michael Saylor's framework: (1) Competitive innovation destroying businesses, (2) Monetary debasement eroding cash value. Both make Bitcoin a necessary hedge. Every business will face these forces within 5 years.

Physical constraints (energy, chips, labor - molecules) limit digital transformation (AI, software, algorithms - bits). AI development is gated by physical infrastructure buildout, not algorithmic breakthroughs alone.
Rapid market corrections enabled by faster AI-driven decision-making. What took 30 years now takes 3 years. More frequent as leverage decreases and AI agents enter decision-making.

Digitization of real-world assets (real estate, stocks, bonds) onto blockchain, enabling fractional ownership, 24/7 trading, and daily liquidity. Jordi sees $700T global net worth redistributing via $100T crypto within a decade.

AI agents making autonomous financial decisions, including capital rotation, tax loss harvesting, and cross-asset allocation. Platforms like Or Public and Figure Markets bring this to retail investors.
Distinction between external accomplishments (what you build/hold) and internal character (how you respond to life's worst moments). Ben Wilson embodies 'being great' during his cancer battle.
Hedge fund term for starting over with a fresh portfolio after a major drawdown. Jordi suggests Leopold's situation was a cleansing event that forced de-risking and re-approach to positions.
